name: Velletri (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Velletri (S.P.Q.V. and three trees on green) on a black eagle beneath a crown, within branches, with the inscription CITTA' DI VELLETRI in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Velletri, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 2 July 2002.
